blindDescriptions.System A: visionOS windowing (visionOS 26 / 2): Single volumetric glass sheet per app, 28-34px corner radius, continuous frosted translucency over live passthrough (saturate 1.6 + blur 28-40px) with specular rim light and true depth shadow (2-layer: 40px/90px). No developer chrome inside stage — status shows time + battery only. One centered window occupies 92% stage width, stacked depth renders via perspective shift + scale 0.92 per layer + real blur falloff, tiled mode uses freeform draggable sheets with magnetic guides not rigid grid. Gaze focus = 4px glow + 1.02 scale on hovered titlebar only, exactly one halo at a time. 260ms prism-ease (0.32,0.72,0,1) interruptible, dismiss via head-flick scrim tap or 320ms slide-back.
blindDescriptions.System B: Horizon OS windowing (Quest 3 v74): Opaque light-grey panels (rgba 0.96) with weak border, flat rectangular windows at fixed 16:9, top bar with traffic-light dots, dock/shelf at bottom with app icons + window previews. Layout is strict 1-2 column grid, no overlapping glass depth — windows tile with splitter handles, stacking is z-lift only. Chrome: window titlebar 48px black, visible resize grips, minimize/maximize/close always visible. Materials read as Android tablets floating, not scrim-over-world. Focus via controller ray or gaze dot but multiple windows stay equally bright; faint 1px blue ring. Motion linear 280-400ms with stop-start jank, no blur interpolation.
blindDescriptions.System C: Artifact under review (Prism 03-wm): 600x600 dark radial stage (components/03-wm/index.html:9-14) with statusbar + two fixed control rows: .edge-row (top:48px) 6 pills (Normal blue + Empty/Loading/Error/Offline/No access) + .wm-toolbar (top:78px) 8 pills ( +Open/ Cycle/ −Minimize active-blue/ ×Close/Overview left, Stacked blue/Tiled right). Below, a single .win-sheet (max 520w 420h, --mat-sheet + --blur-heavy 34px, 26px radius, 24/56 shadow) centered via os.wm layer (blur 6px scrim). Stacked mode offsets -13px Y + scale 0.958 per layer + blur 1.4px + opacity 0.68-1.0 behind top. Tiled mode absolute-position grid (2-col, gap 10px) filling top:116 bottom:52 area. Bottom has .hintbar (2 windows · stacked · Maps) + .dock (Live Captions pill). Overview (backdrop rgba 0.52 blur 18px) shows 2-col cards. Edge states triggered by Normal chips swapping stateLayer.
